fetchProgress: Fetching wrap kernel, cli-node, cc-node, and crag kernel from GitHub
wrapUploaded: Repository wrap kernel updated. Reinstall to apply it to slots.
onlyCodexSelected: All selected slots are Codex slots. A Claude kernel cannot be applied to them.
cragUploaded: Crag kernel uploaded. Switch the data plane to apply it to slots.
uploadTooLarge: The kernel must not exceed 32 MB
description: Switch the data plane and reinstall kernels. Reinstallation preserves credentials, proxies, and containers.
wrapOptionHint: Default. Patched cli-node with 20 native slots per process. kernel.json.claude_bin points to the repository cli-node.
ccOptionHint: Uses the same wrap kernel. claude_bin points to the repository cc-node.
cragOptionHint: Crag kernel with multiple slots per process. claude_bin points to the repository cc-node.
restartAfterSwitch: Restart rust kernel after switching so slots use the selected binary
reinstallDescription: Install kernels for each slot’s current data plane: cli-node + kernel, cc-node + kernel, or crag + cc-node. You can fetch linux amd64 files from GitHub Releases first. Credentials, SOCKS settings, and containers are preserved.
reinstallAllLatest: Reinstall latest kernels on all slots
noRustSlotHint: Files are installed even without rust cli-hop slots, but kernel is not restarted.
rebuildDescription: Use the existing cli-node in share/wrap-cli, add the kernel wrapper / shim, and apply the latest repository kernel. This fails if cli-node is missing. Debian 12 can copy the glibc 2.39 shim from an Ubuntu slot.
fetchDescription: Download linux amd64 wrap kin-kernel, cli-node, cc-node, and crag kin-kernel from the latest Release into the repository. Slots are not changed or restarted.
confirmReinstallAll: Reinstall the latest kernels on all slots?
replaceDescription: Install the kernel for this slot’s current data plane and restart rust kernel. Credentials and containers are preserved.
reinstallLatestDescription: Fetch wrap kernel, cli-node, cc-node, and crag kernel from GitHub, then replace each slot’s kernel according to its data plane. Credentials and containers are preserved.
reinstallSelectedDescription: Install repository kernels according to each slot’s current data plane and show progress. Credentials and containers are preserved.
fetchLatestFirst: Fetch the latest wrap/crag from GitHub first
title: Kernel management
reinstallProgress: Replacing the kernel on {{slot}} for its current data plane
downloadedRelease: Downloaded {{release}}. Not yet applied to slots.
dataplaneDescription: Choose one of three combinations by selecting a card. The default is <wrap>cli-node + kernel</wrap> (20 native slots per process). <cc>cc-node + kernel</cc> uses the same wrap kernel. <crag>crag + cc-node</crag> uses crag kernel with claude_bin pointing to the repository cc-node. With no slots selected, this changes the global default; otherwise it changes only the selected Claude slots. Codex, credentials, and containers stay unchanged.
switchCragDescription: {{scope}} will receive crag kernel with claude_bin set to /home/kincli/.kin/cc-node, then rust kernel will restart. Codex, credentials, and containers stay unchanged.
switchCcDescription: {{scope}} will receive wrap kernel and cc-node, then rust kernel will restart. Codex, credentials, and containers stay unchanged.
switchWrapDescription: {{scope}} will receive wrap kernel and cli-node, then rust kernel will restart. Codex, credentials, and containers stay unchanged.
promoteDescription: Use the working cli-node from {{id}} as the base sample for future reinstalls. Credentials are not copied. The kernel still comes from the repository.
uploadDescription: Replace the repository kernel with {{name}} ({{size}}). Slots are not changed automatically.
syncSummaryMoreFailed_one: {{ok}}/{{count}} slot succeeded; failed: {{failures}} ({{failedCount}} failures in total)
syncSummaryMoreFailed_other: {{ok}}/{{count}} slots succeeded; failed: {{failures}} ({{failedCount}} failures in total)
